info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Consumer Profile API
info.description: The Update Consumer Profile API allows businesses to modify existing consumer details within the system. By providing the consumer ID, users can update personal information and preferences, thereby improving consumer engagement and service customization. This API is primarily utilized by customer service teams and account managers who require up-to-date consumer data for interactions and follow-ups. Efficiently managing consumer information enhances overall operational effectiveness and supports targeted marketing efforts.

put.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific consumer identified by their unique resource identifier. Ensure that all required fields are included in the request body to successfully update the consumer information.

requestBody.description: Updates the details of a consumer identified by the specified resource ID. The request body must contain updated information in JSON format for the consumer identified by 'RES-100045'.

204.description: Request completed successfully, no content returned.
